name: Emergency U-turn at a junction
description: An ambulance enters the northbound approach before the road ahead closes. Its only legal detour starts with a U-turn at M, which must follow an arc instead of flipping 180 degrees in one frame.

lab.expect: The ambulance drives north from A, receives the R2-F closure, turns around through an arc at M, then returns to A and takes the eastern detour to D.
